items.title: Any employee with the support role can take over any customer account
Unrestricted view of a customer's personal data with no consent or masking
Actions taken while impersonating are indistinguishable from the customer's own actions
Impersonating a privileged or staff account to reach admin functions
Impersonation issues a full customer session, so admins can change the account, not just view it
Impersonation session is unbounded in time and survives after the support interaction ends
